steps.reason: Stratified: only 11.7% of the clients subscribe, so an unstratified split could leave the test set with few positives.
Text categories with two to twelve values and no missing values. 'unknown' is kept as a category of its own because a client whose job or contact is unknown may behave differently.

balance, campaign, pdays and previous are heavily skewed with outliers (pdays is -1 for the 82% never contacted), so the robust scaler is used. The model family is open and may include linear models; scaling costs trees nothing and puts linear models on comparable footing.
